rows.grounds: dative epithet of the worshipped deity; compound denotes one whose form is the seat of Śiva
dative epithet of the worshipped deity; compound denotes one having the form of a tamarind tree

items.question: Which specific embodied forms identify the deity addressed in this worship mantra?
premises: The preceding verse prescribes worship using this mantra.
The deity is addressed in the dative as having a form that is Śiva's abode.
The deity is addressed in the dative as having the form of a tamarind tree.
items.inference: The mantra invokes a deity identified both as the abode-form of Śiva and as manifest in the form of a tamarind tree.
uncertainties: The precise ritual or mythic significance of the tamarind-tree form is not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: Worship is offered to the one whose form is the abode of Śiva, to the one in the form of a tamarind tree.
